custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test with 5 in its bin.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
